title: GE Recalls Dishwashers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: An electrical failure in the dishwasher's heating element can pose a fire hazard. Units: About 1.3 million in the United States.

title: Children's Pajamas Recalled by My Clothes Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The pajamas fail to meet the federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injury to children. Units: About 1,100.

title: Patio Bistro Sets Sold at Lowe's Stores Recalled Due to Fall Hazard; Made by Midas Lin Co.
summary: When the chair support bar is not fully engaged, the chair poses a fall hazard to a consumer who sits in the partially engaged chair. Units: About 16,400.

title: Sears Recalls Kenmore® Dehumidifiers Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The dehumidifiers can overheat, smoke, melt and catch on fire, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 795,000.

title: Stage and Riser Caddies Recalled by Midwest Folding Products Due to Risk of Injury or Death Child died when stage stored on caddy fell on her
summary: The caddy's latches do not automatically close to secure the stages and risers when stored. Unsecured stages and risers can fall off the caddies and onto consumers. Units: About 5,300.

title: CareBears Pacifier Recalled by IDM Group Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The pacifiers fail to meet federal safety standards. The nipples can separate from the base, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 119,000.

title: Mansfield Plumbing Products Recalls Bathtubs, Whirlpools and Air Massage Bathtubs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The grab bars used on the products can loosen and break, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 100.

title: Zest Garden Recalls Wilson & Fisher Bistro Sets Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Big Lots Stores
summary: The chairs can break during normal use, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 22,500.

title: Energizer Recalls Night Lights Due to Burn Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Target
summary: The night lights can overheat and smoke, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 260,000.

title: Kawasaki Recalls Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Injury, Death Hazard
summary: The steering gear assembly and front brakes can fail, resulting in the loss of steering and braking, posing a risk of injury or death. Units: About 7,000.

title: Kickboard USA Recalls Children's Scooter Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The one-piece plastic platform that covers the front wheel base can break, posing a laceration hazard to children. Units: About 5,600.

title: LG Electronics and Sears Recall Gas Dryers For Repair Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The gas valve in the recalled dryers can fail to shut off properly, continuing to heat the dryer and its contents after the drying cycle is complete. High temperatures inside and on the exterior surface of the dryers can scorch the drum, as well as burn or damage the dryer contents, posing a risk of

title: Babylicious Recalls Cloth Crib Fringe Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The narrow fabric strip connecting individual fabric triangles presents a strangulation hazard to young children. Units: About 300.

title: Ceiling Fans Recalled by Emerson Air Comfort Products Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The ceiling fan's hanger bracket can spread apart due to heat from the motor and/or out-of-balance operation, causing the fan to fall from the ceiling. This poses a risk of injury to bystanders. Units: About 870.

title: Gerber Recalls Machetes Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: A weakness in the area where the handle meets the blade can cause the handle or the blade to break during use, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 119,000.

title: Heated Mats for Pets Recalled by World Class Due to Fire and Electrical Shock Hazards to Consumers; Sold Exclusively at Amazon.com
summary: The heated mats have poor wiring and construction, posing a fire and electrical shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 25.

title: PBteen Recalls Bunk Beds Due to Risk of Injury
summary: The front upper horizontal panel on the bunk beds can crack or break, posing a risk of injury to the consumer. Units: About 390.

title: Baby Seats Recalled for Repair by Bumbo International Due to Fall Hazard
summary: Babies can maneuver out of or fall from the Bumbo seat, posing a risk of serious injuries. Units: About 4 million in the U.S. Note: In October 2007, 1 million Bumbo seats were voluntarily recalled to provide additional warnings against use on raised surfaces..

title: Canon Recalls for Repair EOS Rebel T4i Digital Cameras Due to Risk of Allergic Reaction
summary: A chemical used in the camera's rubber grips can result in a reaction that changes the grips from black to white and poses a risk of skin irritation to the consumer. Units: About 68,200.

title: Toysmith Recalls Animal Snap Bracelets Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The metal snap band can wear through the fabric covering resulting in exposing sharp edges and posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 89,500 units.

title: Avalanche Airbags Recalled by Snowpulse Due to Risk of Injury1
summary: A leak in the airbag's cartridge can result in the airbag not deploying, posing a risk of death and injury in the event of an avalanche. Units: About 1,200 in the United States and 2,600 in Canada.

title: BatteriesPlus Expands Recall of Battery Packs Used with Cordless Tools Due to Explosion Hazard
summary: The replacement battery pack can explode unexpectedly, posing a risk of injury to consumers. Units: About 65,300 (about 111,800 were recalled in December 2011)..

title: Cost Plus Recalls Silk Floor Mats Due to Laceration Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Cost Plus World Market
summary: The recalled silk mats can have a tack or staple woven into the fabric strips. The tack or staple can cut consumers, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 17,000.

title: DeVilbiss Air Power Co Recalls Air Compressors Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The air compressor motor can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 460,000.

title: Inflatable Recreational Tubes Recalled by Tractor Supply Due to Chemical Burn and Irritation Hazard
summary: Contact with the inflatable tube can result in severe skin irritation or burns. Units: About 10,900.

title: Meijer Stores Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: Pedals on the bicycles can loosen or detach during use, posing a fall hazard to the rider. Units: About 68,000.

title: Mr. Coffee Single Cup Brewers Recalled by JCS Due to Burn Hazard
summary: A build-up of steam in the water reservoir can force the brewing chamber open and expel hot coffee grounds and water, posing a burn hazard. Units: 520,000 in the United States and 80,700 in Canada.

title: Shimano Recalls to Repair PRO VIBE Bicycle Handlebars Due to a Fall Hazard
summary: The recalled handlebars can break during riding, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 67.

title: Specialized Bicycle Components Expands Recall of Bike Brake Levers Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The adjuster cap and brake cable can slide out of position and make the brakes non-operational. This can cause a rider to lose control of the bicycle and crash. Units: About 100 (about 600 of the 2010 and 2011 Shiv Modules and 2012 Shiv TT modules were recalled in April 2012).

title: Cooper Lighting Recalls Shower Light Trim and Glass Lens Due to Impact and Laceration Hazards1
summary: The shower light's trim and glass lens can fall from the ceiling fixture, posing an impact and laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 50,400.

title: Summer Infant Recalls to Repair Baby Bathers Due to Fall and Head Injury Hazard Consumers should order free repair kit
summary: When the bather is lifted and/or carried with an infant in it, its folding wire frame can suddenly disengage from the side hinge, dropping the baby out of the bather, posing a fall hazard and a risk of serious head injury to infants. Units: About 2 million in the United States and an additional 65,0

title: Eecycleworks Recalls Bicycle Brakes Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The bridge of the brakes can crack, posing a fall hazard to riders. Units: About 400.

title: Sherwin-Williams Recalls Dupli-Color Automotive Paint Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The aerosol paint canister can leak, posing a fire hazard to consumers if the paint can is stored near a source of ignition. Units: About 2,700.

title: Sherwin-Williams Recalls Krylon Glaze and Acrylic Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The aerosol canister can leak, posing a fire hazard to consumers if the can is stored near a source of ignition. Units: About 98,400.

title: Sherwin-Williams Recalls Tree House Acrylic Coating Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Hobby Lobby
summary: The aerosol canister can leak, posing a fire hazard to consumers if the can is stored near a source of ignition. Units: About 17,850.
